name: Amherst (United States)
description: Red field with a light blue stripe near the bottom, a large yellow letter A from top to bottom near the hoist, the town seal with a wreath and the date 1818 in the upper fly and AMHERST N.Y. in yellow.
history: Amherst is a town in Erie County, New York. Flags of the World records that the flag was chosen in a contest held at the initiative of a former town executive, Daniel Ward.
